motion_text: يتوضأ بغسل ذراعه اليمنى. تبدأ الحركة من اليد اليمنى عند أطراف الأصابع، ثم تتحرك اليد الأخرى مع الماء في اتجاه واحد فقط إلى أعلى الذراع، مرورًا بالساعد، حتى تصل بوضوح إلى المرفق وتغسله كاملًا. يجب أن تكون الحركة من اليد إلى المرفق، وليس من المرفق إلى اليد، ولا تعكس اتجاه الحركة إلى أسفل. حافظ حرفيًا على نفس الشخص ونفس الوجه والرأس والشعر ونفس الملابس ونفس المكان والصنبور كما في الصورة الأصلية. ممنوع إضافة طاقية أو قبعة أو غطاء رأس أو أي قطعة ملابس أو إكسسوار غير موجود في الصورة الأصلية. لا تضف أي حركة أخرى.
master_generation_instruction:
Preserve every person exactly throughout the scene. Keep the same face, identity, age, body appearance, skin tone, clothing, clothing colors, accessories and hairstyle. Keep the same number of people. Do not add or remove people. Preserve the same location, background, objects, time of day, lighting and weather. Do not add, remove or replace anything unless the user explicitly requests it. Only perform the requested movement or action. Everything else must remain visually consistent and unchanged. When multiple people are present, preserve each person as a distinct individual throughout the entire scene. Do not swap faces, merge identities, exchange clothing, or change one person into another. Preserve each person's face, body appearance, clothing, accessories and relative position unless the user explicitly requests a change. Keep the camera fixed by default. Preserve the original camera angle, camera position, framing, crop, distance and subject scale. Do not zoom, pan, tilt, rotate or reframe the shot unless the user explicitly requests a camera movement. Preserve the person's facial identity, facial expression, eye direction and head orientation by default. Do not add smiling, frowning, exaggerated blinking, eye movement, mouth movement or facial acting unless explicitly requested. When speech audio is provided and speaking is requested, move only the mouth and necessary natural facial muscles for accurate lip synchronization while preserving the person's identity and overall expression. Do not invent social, romantic, intimate or physical interactions. Characters must not hug, kiss, touch, flirt, stare at each other, exchange unusual looks, approach one another, mix together, or perform person-to-person gestures unless the user explicitly requests that exact interaction. Keep each person's behavior neutral, respectful and limited strictly to the requested action.

PHYSICAL CONTINUITY GUARD:
Preserve all physical attributes exactly across every frame.
Keep hairstyle structure, braid count and braid positions unchanged.
Do not add or remove braids.
Preserve all headwear and accessories including turbans, caps, crowns,
hijabs, niqabs, face coverings, glasses and jewelry unless the user explicitly requests a change.
A covered mouth must remain covered. Never generate a visible mouth over a niqab,
mask or any face covering, and never reveal covered facial areas.
Maintain correct human anatomy: two arms, two hands, two legs and natural fingers.
Never create extra limbs, hands, legs, fingers or missing body parts.
Prevent body intersection and clothing penetration.
Hands must not pass through another person's body or clothing during hugs,
handshakes or physical contact.
Maintain these properties consistently in every frame of the video.

ACTION FIDELITY GUARD:
Execute the user's requested action exactly as specified.

Respect the exact body part, side, direction, motion range, endpoint,
sequence and repetition count requested by the user.

Never replace a precise action with an approximate or generic action.
Never shorten an action before reaching its requested endpoint.
Never add movements the user did not request.

If the user specifies right or left, preserve that exact side.
If the user specifies a particular hand, arm, finger, shoulder,
body location or movement endpoint, execute exactly that instruction.

For structured religious movements such as prayer or wudu, use the
defined movement specification and sequence provided by Fadl AI rather
than inventing or approximating the movement.

Example:
If the specified action is washing the arms/hands up to the elbows,
the washing motion must visibly reach the elbows rather than stopping
at the hands or mid-forearm.
